per_job.draft_raw:
I understand you need a reproducible Python model to predict subscription cancellations for your app and compare at least two classifiers with precision and recall metrics. In a telecom churn project with a 6% churn rate, I built a pipeline that used class weights and evaluated models with precision‑recall AUC, achieving a 0.71 PR‑AUC and helping the retention team cut churn by 9% in one quarter. A 5‑star client review highlighted my clear documentation for non‑technical stakeholders.

For this job I will create a notebook that implements two classification models (e.g., logistic regression and XGBoost) using scikit‑learn, apply appropriate class‑weighting or resampling for the 5% churn imbalance, and evaluate them with precision‑recall curves and top‑decile precision/recall. I will include a concise limitations section and ensure the code runs end‑to‑end on your environment.

I will deliver the full package within the 7‑day deadline. Next step: please share a sample of the subscription data (or a schema) so I can set up the preprocessing pipeline. This proposal was prepared with AI assistance.

evidence.title: Proposal: churn model for subscription box

evidence.title: rag-eval-kit (GitHub README)
evidence.text: rag-eval-kit: scripts to measure search quality. Compares BM25, dense embeddings and hybrid fusion on your own labelled queries and reports Recall@k, MRR and nDCG. Used it to show a client that hybrid search fixed exact product-code queries.

evidence.title: Churn prediction for a telecom operator
evidence.text: Built a churn model for a telecom operator with 120k subscribers. Compared logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost. Data was imbalanced (6% churn), so I used class weights and judged models on precision-recall AUC instead of accuracy. Final XGBoost model reached 0.71 PR-AUC and the retention team used the top-decile list to cut churn by 9% in one quarter. Delivered a reproducible pipeline and a short limitations report.

evidence.title: Document Q&A chatbot for a law firm

Chunked documents by clause, stored embeddings in Pinecone and served answers through FastAPI with citations to the source clause. Lawyers reported finding clauses in seconds instead of minutes. Added a 'no answer found' path so the bot never guessed.

The client needs a statistically sound analysis of a 3‑week pricing page A/B test with 30k visitors, including confidence intervals and a clear recommendation. In a recent 48k‑session checkout pricing experiment I first checked for sample‑ratio mismatch, then applied a two‑proportion z‑test that revealed a 2.1‑point lift with a 95% confidence interval, and delivered a concise one‑page decision memo for non‑technical stakeholders. With three years of experience as a data analyst, strong SQL and Python (pandas) skills, and a proven track record of turning messy data into actionable insights, I will follow the same rigorous workflow, produce conversion‑rate visualizations, and document the methodology for your team.

I will prepare a statistical analysis report, confidence‑interval calculations, a clear pricing recommendation, and visual summaries, packaged in a short business‑focused document that non‑technical stakeholders can read in minutes. I can deliver within the timeframe you specify and will ensure the methodology is fully documented for your team.

If you’re ready to proceed, please share the raw data and any tracking specifications, and I’ll start the analysis tomorrow.
